title: Supervised Learning with Quantum Hamiltonian Embeddings
abstract: arXiv:2610.26833v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Machine learning is widely regarded as a promising application in which quantum computing could offer a computational advantage. However, general quantum machine learning models with provable guarantees on performance, trainability, and efficient inference remain limited. In this work, we introduce quantum Hamiltonian embeddings, a supervised learning framework in which a classical training dataset is encoded into a single effective, parameterized Hamiltonian. Training optimizes the parameters of this data-dependent Hamiltonian, whose approximate ground state defines the classification rule. Once the ground state has been approximated using a quantum algorithm, inference can be performed either classically using a classical representation of the learned state, or with a quantum representation of the state. translated_title: 基于量子哈密顿量嵌入的监督学习
translated_abstract: 机器学习被广泛认为是量子计算可能提供计算优势的一个有前景的应用领域。然而，能够在性能、可训练性和高效推理方面提供可证明保证的通用量子机器学习模型仍然有限。在这项工作中，我们提出了量子哈密顿量嵌入，这是一种监督学习框架，将经典训练数据集编码为一个单一有效的参数化哈密顿量。训练过程通过优化这个依赖数据的哈密顿量的参数来进行，其近似基态定义了分类规则。一旦利用量子算法近似得到基态，推理既可以经典地执行（使用学习态的经典表示），也可以使用该态的量子表示来执行。我们建立了高效的梯度估计方法，并证明了良好的泛化性保证。此外，在（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了一种量子哈密顿量嵌入监督学习框架，将经典训练数据编码为参数化哈密顿量，通过优化哈密顿量参数使近似基态定义分类规则，同时提供了高效的梯度估计方法与泛化性理论保证。
en_tdlr: We introduce quantum Hamiltonian embeddings, a supervised learning framework that encodes classical training data into a single parameterized Hamiltonian whose approximate ground state defines the classification rule, with efficient gradient estimation methods and provable generalization guarantees.
